items.title: Pre-market action: Here's the trade setup for today's session
items.description: On Friday, Indian equities experienced a minor decline, with Nifty ending the day lower due to weak global cues and profit booking activity. Despite this, analysts are optimistic about the week ahead, supported by solid domestic fundamentals and a reduction in geopolitical tensions.

items.title: FPIs turn buyers in IT stocks for first time in 2026, invest Rs 3,358 crore in July
items.description: In July, overseas investors turned their attention to Indian IT stocks, marking the first instance of such purchases this year. The consumer durables and healthcare sectors also witnessed a surge in foreign portfolio investments. By mid-July, foreign investors emerged as net buyers in equities, expanding their investments in consumer services, automobiles, and chemicals, although they offloaded shares in metals, mining, power, and financial services.

items.title: Govt taps inputs from public sector banks to lure foreign capital
items.description: Government will meet state-owned lenders to attract foreign investment. This aims to stabilize the rupee and bridge the current-account gap. The meeting will also focus on deposit mobilization and supporting small businesses. Fresh foreign capital inflows will boost reserves and domestic manufacturing. Durable foreign direct investment is preferred over short-term deposits.

items.title: Purchase of bad loans by ARCs rises 56% in Q1
items.description: Asset reconstruction companies bought twenty-six thousand three hundred four crore rupees of bad loans. This acquisition saw a fifty-six percent increase from the previous year's figures. The overall non-performing asset ratio in the banking system continued its downward trend. Banks have been resolving legacy stressed assets for several years now. Transactions are increasingly being settled in cash and through security receipts.

items.title: As banks shrink microfinance books, bigger MFIs prepare to grab the gap
items.description: Large microfinance companies including Muthoot Microfin and Satin Creditcare have raised their growth forecasts as private banks, small finance banks and smaller MFIs scale back lending. Improving asset quality is also supporting expansion by larger, well-capitalised microfinance lenders.

items.title: Positive Breakout: These 10 stocks cross above their 200 DMAs
items.description: In the Nifty500 pack, 10 stocks' closing prices crossed above their 200 DMA (Daily Moving Averages) on August 7, 2026, according to stockedge.com's technical scan data. Traders use the 200-day daily moving average (DMA) as a key indicator to determine a stock's overall trend. As long as the stock is priced above the 200-day SMA on the daily timeframe, it is generally considered to be in an overall uptrend. Take a look:

items.title: Nifty above 24,500, but volatility clouds path to 25,000: Analysts
items.description: The Nifty index has moved past a significant resistance level, indicating potential further gains. Analysts suggest buying opportunities on dips for the Nifty index. Hindustan Aeronautics and Artemis Medicare are highlighted as top stock picks for the week. Union Bank of India and Mahindra & Mahindra also present strong buying prospects. State Bank of India and Amara Raja Energy & Mobility show strengthening momentum.

items.title: Stocks in news: Titan, SBI, Ola Electric, Astra Microwave and Hindalco
items.description: Markets closed lower Friday amid mixed global cues and rising crude oil. Analysts remain bullish on Nifty above 24,350. Focus on Titan's strong Q1 profit, SBI's earnings beat, and Ola Electric's narrower loss. Hindalco also posted record profits. Maruti Suzuki anticipates significant passenger vehicle sales growth.

items.title: Kaynes Tech shares crash 8% after weak Q1 results: What are Nomura and Motilal Oswal saying
items.description: Kaynes Technology shares tanked 8% after the electronics manufacturing services firm reported a 24.4% YoY decline in Q1 FY27 net profit to Rs 56.4 crore. Revenue, however, surged 40.5% to Rs 946 crore, while EBITDA rose 29.5% to Rs 147.5 crore. The EBITDA margin narrowed to 15.6% from 16.7%, reflecting pressure on profitability despite strong revenue growth.

items.title: Titan shares gain 2% after Q1 results. What are Citi, Motilal, two other brokerages saying?
items.description: Titan shares gained 2% after the company reported a 63% YoY rise in Q1 profit. Citi and Motilal Oswal retained their Buy ratings, while Nuvama downgraded the stock to Hold and Emkay maintained Add. Here’s what the four brokerages recommend.

items.title: Tata Technologies among 5 stocks flashing bullish signals. Upside on cards?
items.description: On August 7, five Nifty500 stocks that gained more than 4% featured on StockEdge’s ‘White Marubozu’ bullish scanner, according to its technical scan data.A White Marubozu is a bullish candlestick pattern in technical analysis, formed when a stock opens at or near its low and closes at or near its high. The pattern appears as a long white or green candle with little to no upper or lower shadow, signalling strong buying pressure throughout the session.Traders often view the pattern as an indication that buyers remained firmly in control from the opening to the close, potentially signalling further strength.

items.title: Sensex, Nifty hold steady as strong earnings offset oil worries
items.description: On Monday, Indian stock markets witnessed a flat start, bolstered by robust first-quarter earnings. While the Sensex remained mostly unchanged, the Nifty crossed the crucial 24,580 mark. Leading the gains were Titan and ICICI Bank, whereas NTPC and Bajaj Finance showed some declines. Analysts express cautious optimism, attributing this to strong domestic demand and foreign institutional investor activity. Market trends indicate a potential consolidation within a defined trading range.

items.title: Buy, Sell or Hold: Elara Capital raises target price on BEML; Citi remains bullish on Titan Company
items.description: Brokerages remain bullish on BEML, Titan and Fortis Healthcare, citing strong earnings, improving margins and growth prospects. Elara sees 58% upside in BEML, while Citi targets 5,700 for Titan and Nuvama sees 19% upside in Fortis Healthcare.

items.title: SBI shares rise nearly 2% after Q1 beat. Here's what Nomura, Morgan Stanley and other top brokerages expect next
items.description: SBI shares gained 1.55% after the lender reported a 10% YoY rise in Q1 FY27 standalone net profit to Rs 21,121 crore, beating Street estimates. Net interest income rose 15% to Rs 46,992 crore, while operating profit increased 10%. Domestic NIM improved to 3%, while whole-bank NIM rose 5 bps sequentially to 2.86%.

items.title: Siemens Energy India among 4 stocks that show bullish RSI upswing
items.description: On August 7, four Nifty500 stocks that gained over 4% featured in the RSI Trending Up scan, based on data from StockEdge. An uptrend signal is triggered when the RSI crosses above 50 from below. A rising RSI indicates strengthening price momentum and can help traders identify potential buying opportunities.

items.title: How Rakesh Jhunjhunwala's old Tata bet created Rs 80,000 crore wealth after two years of flat returns
items.description: In 2026 so far, Titan has experienced a remarkable surge in market value, driven by consistent jewellery demand and the rise of organized players. The company's robust performance can be attributed to the effective strategies employed by Tanishq and CaratLane. Moreover, Titan is expanding beyond jewellery into watches and eyecare. This promising trajectory is further reinforced by strong Q1 earnings, boosting investor confidence significantly.

items.title: Anawil Wire & Engineering shares to list today; GMP points to 21% premium ahead of debut
items.description: Anawil Wire & Engineering is set to list on the NSE SME platform today, August 10, with a 21% grey market premium (GMP) signalling a strong debut. Its IPO was subscribed 149.13 times, led by NII demand at 233.36 times, followed by QIBs at 164.56 times and retail investors at 104.22 times.

items.title: How Adani’s $125 billion capex boom is creating new winners on Dalal Street
items.description: Adani Group's massive investments in infrastructure are proving advantageous for various publicly traded companies. These affiliates are not only seeing significant growth in their order books but also witnessing an upsurge in stock valuations. With a focus on expansion, Adani considers these businesses as essential collaborators, driving progress in the engineering and technology sectors and transforming revenue streams across multiple industries.

items.title: Dynamatic Technologies shares soar 9% after Q1 profit jumps 93% YoY to Rs 21 crore; outlook stays strong
items.description: Dynamatic Technologies shares surged 12% after the company reported a near-doubling in Q1 FY27 net profit to Rs 20.79 crore. Revenue rose 14.5% year-on-year to Rs 424.81 crore, while EBITDA jumped 45.9% to Rs 55.11 crore. EBITDA margin expanded 280 basis points to 13%, with EBIT rising 83.7% and EBIT margin improving 310 basis points.

items.title: Cupid shares fall 2% even as Q1 profit jumps 3x. What’s ahead for multibagger stock that rose 680% in a year?
items.description: Cupid shares fell on Monday despite a threefold rise in Q1 FY27 profit to Rs 44 crore, as revenue surged 159% and EBITDA jumped 265%. The multibagger stock has gained 150% in 2026 and 683% over the past year. The company has also raised its FY27 revenue and profit guidance.

items.title: Top Nifty50 stocks analysts suggest buying in this volatile week
items.description: Stock Reports Plus, powered by Refinitiv, is a comprehensive report that evaluates five key components of 4,000+ listed stocks – earnings, fundamentals, relative valuation, risk, and price momentum – to generate standardized scores. The simple average of the above-mentioned five component ratings is normally distributed to reach an average score.

items.title: Ola Electric shares fall 6% even as Q1 loss narrows. Why brokerages see up to 51% downside
items.description: Ola Electric shares fell after the company reported a narrower Q1 FY27 net loss of Rs 336 crore, compared with Rs 428 crore a year ago. However, revenue from operations declined 45% YoY to Rs 455 crore, despite rising 72% QoQ from Rs 265 crore in Q4 FY26.

items.title: Sky Gold and Diamonds shares rally 10% after Q1 profit soars 141% YoY, revenue rises 78%
items.description: Sky Gold and Diamonds shares surged after the jewellery manufacturer reported strong Q1 FY27 results, with revenue rising 78% and net profit jumping 141% YoY. The stock is also up sharply over the past year, while rising FII and mutual fund holdings add to investor interest.

items.title: Delhivery shares plunge 4% as net profit tumbles 65% YoY. Why Nuvama still maintains Buy rating
items.description: Delhivery shares fell 4% after the logistics company reported a 65% YoY decline in Q1 FY27 net profit to Rs 32 crore, despite a 28% rise in revenue. Nuvama retained its Buy rating but cut the target price to Rs 570.

items.title: Raymond Realty shares fall 8% as profitability takes a hit  in Q1
items.description: Raymond Realty shares fell 8% after Q1 earnings showed pressure on profitability despite a 37% year-on-year rise in total income to Rs 536 crore. Higher upfront project, marketing and interest costs weighed on profit. However, bookings doubled to Rs 700 crore, while collections rose 47%, supporting the company’s growth outlook.

items.title: PFC shares tumble 5% to 4-month low after weak Q1 earnings. Why Motilal Oswal still recommends Buy
items.description: PFC shares fell over 5% after the company reported a 2% YoY rise in Q1 FY27 consolidated net profit to Rs 7,012 crore. Motilal Oswal retained its Buy rating but cut its target price to Rs 500, citing lower loan growth and margin pressure.

items.title: Milky Mist Dairy Food IPO opens tomorrow, GMP signals 20% listing gain. Check price band, lot size and key dates
items.description: Milky Mist Dairy Food IPO opens on August 11 and closes on August 13, with the Rs 1,553 crore issue priced at Rs 133-140 per share. The latest GMP of Rs 26 signals a potential 19% listing gain, while investors can check the lot size, key dates and IPO details here.

items.title: Paytm shares jump 5% after Bernstein assigns target price above IPO price for first time
items.description: Paytm shares rallied after Bernstein raised its target price to Rs 2,200, implying 52% upside, while retaining an Outperform rating. The target is the highest on the Street and the first above Paytm’s Rs 2,150 IPO price, with Bernstein factoring in UPI MDR from FY28.

items.title: Aarti Pharmalabs shares hit 20% upper circuit as Q1 net profit surges 65% YoY to Rs 76 crore
items.description: Aarti Pharmalabs shares hit the 20% upper circuit after the company reported a 65.4% year-on-year rise in Q1 FY27 net profit to Rs 76.14 crore. Revenue surged 38.7% to Rs 535.79 crore, while the company also approved a Rs 149-crore capex plan to expand manufacturing capacity.

items.title: Hitachi Energy jumps 7% after Q1 results. Here's why Nomura initiated coverage on stock
items.description: Hitachi Energy India shares jumped over 7% after the company reported a 123.5% YoY rise in Q1 FY26 profit. Nomura initiated coverage with a Buy rating and Rs 40,030 target, citing strong order inflows, rising T&D demand and multiple growth opportunities.

items.title: Stock picks of the week:  5 stocks with consistent score improvement and upside potential of upto 30%
items.description: Around three months back, there was a trade which was taking place on the street, “sell-software-services-stocks”. Today there are signs that it might be halting. What needs to be watched is whether along with this a reversal of the AI trade takes place or not in global markets. If that were to happen then there is a probability that we might see inflows coming back to emerging markets including India. Our selected stocks for today depict a strong upward trajectory in their overall average score which is based on five key pillars: Earnings, fundamentals, relative valuation, risk, and price momentum. This implies that there has been a significant improvement in their market outlook in the given time frame.

items.title: $48 billion profit! 5 global oil majors cash in on oil surge amid Iran war. Where is money flowing?
items.description: Five global oil majors — Exxon Mobil, Chevron, BP, Shell and TotalEnergies — posted a combined $48 billion profit in Q2, benefiting from oil prices surging above $100 a barrel amid US-Iran hostilities. Their combined cash generation hit a record $90 billion, surpassing levels seen after Russia’s 2022 invasion of Ukraine. The bumper profits also drew criticism from US President Donald Trump over high fuel prices.

items.title: Pix Transmissions shares surge over 12% after Q1 profit spikes 98% YoY
items.description: Pix Transmissions shares surged after the company reported a 97.8% YoY jump in Q1 FY27 PAT to Rs 4,829 crore. Revenue from operations rose 21.6% YoY to Rs 13,453 crore, while total comprehensive income increased 98% to Rs 4,817.52 crore.

items.title: Vedanta Oil and Gas shares surge 12% to fresh record high. What should investors do?
items.description: Vedanta Oil and Gas shares rose sharply on Monday after CRISIL upgraded the company’s long-term credit rating. The company reported a sharp turnaround in Q1 FY27, posting a net profit of Rs 945 crore. Here’s a look at its financial performance, growth plans and key factors investors should consider.

items.title: Hindalco share price: Why brokerages are reiterating their Buy calls, raising target prices after Q1 earnings
items.description: Hindalco shares fell despite the company reporting a record Q1 profit. However, brokerages remained bullish, citing strong India operations, improving downstream mix and a recovery at Novelis, while raising their target prices and retaining Buy ratings on the stock.
